fields.description: Per card, and THE number for this type — every GPU of it fetches this, so nvidia-smi's 15 and AWS's 16 for one T4 stop disagreeing. Seeded by whichever scan resolved it first and never overwritten after; correct it here and the whole fleet follows.
fields.label: VRAM (GB)

fields.description: What the card can do, from nvidia-smi's compute_cap: 7.5 is a T4, 8.0 an A100, 8.9 an L40S, 12.0 a Blackwell. bfloat16 needs 8.0 and an fp8 KV cache needs 8.9, so this is what says a box can run a model's dtype before a play starts. 0 means never scanned — the check is skipped rather than failed, the same reading a blank CPU architecture gets.
fields.label: Compute Capability

fields.description: Every string a source has reported for this card. Filled by scanning, so it learns. Matched before the name is derived, so an alias added here beats what would be derived — which is the only way 'NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3' reaches H100.
fields.label: Aliases
